findings.claim: Malformed agent messages can still leave partial mutations on an already-existing A2UI surface because rollback only deletes newly-created surfaces.
findings.evidence: Acceptance evidence requires validation failures to fail closed and prevent invalid agent output from leaving partial UI state; however `processAgentSurface` records only `newSurfaceIds` for surfaces that do not already exist before `agentA2uiRuntime.processMessages(messages)`, and the catch block only deletes those new surfaces (lines 24-45), so a batch that validly updates an existing surface before throwing on a later invalid component is not rolled back.
findings.suggested_fix: Validate the entire message batch before applying it, or snapshot/clone affected existing surfaces and restore them on any processing error rather than only deleting newly-created surfaces.
